name: tar
description: Bundles several files into a single archive (tape archive), optionally compressed. You pick an action (c create, x extract, t list), then options; f is followed by the archive name, so it must come last in a group such as -czvf.

options.description: Extracts the contents of an archive.
Lists the contents of an archive without extracting it.
Name of the archive file to create or read.
Prints the files as they are processed.
Changes to this directory before acting (where to extract to).
Adds files to the end of an existing (uncompressed) archive.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Files or directories to archive, or to extract from the archive.

examples.explanation: Creates (c) a gzip-compressed (z) archive of project/, printing (v) the files, in project.tar.gz (f).
Extracts the archive into the current directory.
Extracts into /opt; recent versions of tar detect the compression on their own when extracting.

dangerNote: When extracting, existing files with the same name are overwritten. List the contents with -t first if in doubt.
